title: spec(auth-capture): propose card network binding
quote: Proposes cards as a network binding of auth-capture, so a buyer without a funded wallet can pay over x402. The client presents an opaque PSP token, the facilitator authorizes before the resource runs, and the resource server captures or voids afterwards. Delegated authority, card micropayments, step-up challenges, and post-settlement events are deferred to follow-up proposals.
